scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Samajik Suraksha Yojana: Death & Funeral Assistance (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: The applicant must be a nominee or legal heir of the deceased construction worker.
The deceased worker must have been registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Application is allowed only once per eligible beneficiary.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹5,00,000 financial assistance to the nominee/legal heir of a registered construction worker who dies in an accident, and an additional ₹15,000 for funeral expenses.
